raw_content:
```yaml
---
id: vuln-openslides-auth-service-70c1aa9f
pattern: |
  $X isPasswordCorrect:FUNC($Y, $Z)
  if !$X.isExisting() || !$X.password || !$X.is_active
  if $X.password && $X.isExisting() && $X.is_active
message: "Potential security vulnerability: Insecure password checking"
severity: ERROR
languages:
  - typescript
metadata:
  CVE: CVE-2026-25519
  CWE: CWE-284
  verified: true
taint-mode:
  source-pattern: |
    $X.password
  sink-pattern: |
    if !$X.password || !$X.isExisting() || !$X.is_active
```
This Semgrep rule will detect the vulnerability where the password checking is not done correctly. The original version of the code checks if the user exists, if the password is set and if the user is active before checking the password. The patched version checks if the password is set, if the user exists and if the user is active before checking the password. This difference is what Semgrep will detect.
